name: Master synthetic legal taxonomy experiment
recommended_task: Hierarchical or composite-label legal classification: domain then domain-qualified label. Keep separate from Contra's contract-clause classifier head.
provenance: User supplied; generator, source inputs, generation prompts, and model/version were not included.
publication: Manifest, taxonomy, and bundle are Git-ignored pending documented redistribution rights.
limitations: The taxonomy contains label names but no reviewed legal definitions.
All text inputs contain the target label phrase, making classification answer-revealing.
Nine label names occur in more than one domain and require domain-qualified IDs.
Synthetic evaluation is not an independent measure of real-world legal performance.
Structured analysis fields are generic scaffolding, not authoritative statements of law.
